notes: Sky page: SHIPS. The radio can now listen for ships on the Chesapeake - they appear on the Map as boat shapes pointing the way they are going (hollow = stopped or at anchor), with channel markers as small diamonds. Tap a ship for its name, flag, type, speed, destination and track; there is a Ships list under the planes and a Ships heard card in the Logbook. New radio modes: Auto (balloons, then planes), Ships (balloons, then ships), Planes, Balloons, Off. Satellite pictures are switched off until a proper satellite antenna is up.
